name: ocrespond
title: When on-call work reaches you
heading: From an unassigned incident to the person who takes it
tags: Observed in the pdi2 mirror · 19 Oct 2026
foot: The trigger rule engine, the On-Call: Assign By Acknowledgement subflows, the email, SMS and voice channel settings and the reply rule, read from the pdi2 mirror on 19 Oct 2026. Nothing of it runs on pdi2 yet: no group has a shift and there are no trigger rules.
